name: Web Design Guidelines
description: Review UI code for Web Interface Guidelines compliance. Use when asked to "review my UI", "check accessibility", "audit design", "review UX", or check a site against best practices.

promptPatterns: \b(review my ui|check accessibility|audit design|review ux|ui 审查|design audit|interface guidelines)\b

commands.description: Audit UI against web design guidelines
commands.injectPrompt: Apply the web-design-guidelines skill: audit the UI code against interface guidelines — accessibility (WCAG), semantics, focus management, responsive behavior, and platform conventions — and report violations with fixes.
